notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
